en: Historic black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a European town market square. Several multi‑storey buildings with steep tiled roofs and ornate façades line the square. Shop signs and a hotel sign are visible on the ground floors. A horse‑drawn wagon stands near a decorative fountain or well in the open square, and a lone woman in a long dress walks across the empty space. The caption at the top reads "Wurzen. Markt." and a printer credit with date appears at the bottom.
